F5 Patches Critical BIG-IP APM Zero-Day Exploited for Unauthenticated RCE on OAuth Servers
stories.abstract: F5 has confirmed active exploitation of a critical remote code execution vulnerability, CVE-2026-94127, affecting BIG-IP APM systems configured as OAuth authorization servers. Unauthenticated attackers can leverage this flaw to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable appliances.
stories.why: This vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution on critical network infrastructure, posing a severe risk of full system compromise.
stories.action: Apply the relevant F5 engineering hotfixes immediately to all affected BIG-IP APM instances.

New CVSS 10.0 VeloCloud Orchestrator Flaw Actively Exploited in Certificate-Based Setups
stories.abstract: Arista Networks has released patches for a critical zero-day vulnerability in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator deployments. Tracked as CVE-2026-93952, the flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise the host system. The vulnerability is currently being actively exploited in the wild.
stories.why: This flaw enables unauthorized remote access to SD-WAN management infrastructure, posing a severe risk to network integrity and control.
stories.action: Update VeloCloud Orchestrator to the latest patched version immediately.

MikroTrick Chain Let Attackers Take Over MikroTik Routers Without a Password or SSH Key
stories.abstract: Researchers identified a vulnerability chain dubbed MikroTrick affecting MikroTik RouterOS. By combining an SSH state-machine flaw with an argument-injection bug, unauthenticated attackers can bypass authentication mechanisms to gain full administrative control over internet-facing devices.
stories.why: This exploit allows remote, unauthenticated root access to network infrastructure, posing a critical risk to edge devices.
stories.action: Update MikroTik RouterOS to the latest patched version immediately.

Botslab G980H Dashcams
stories.abstract: Multiple critical vulnerabilities in Botslab G980H dashcams allow attackers to bypass authentication, access sensitive data, alter device configurations, and disrupt operations. These flaws affect specific firmware versions of the G980H series, posing significant risks to user privacy and device integrity.
stories.why: Compromised dashcams can serve as entry points into local networks or be used to exfiltrate sensitive location and video data.
stories.action: Update Botslab G980H firmware to the latest available version immediately.

stories.abstract: A malicious actor is leveraging automated AI tools to conduct end-to-end cyberattacks against e-commerce platforms. stories.why: The integration of AI into the full attack chain significantly lowers the barrier to entry for complex, large-scale automated exploitation of retail infrastructure.

Placeholder third-party[.]com Referenced Across 1,700+ Repositories Now Serves Malicious Content
stories.abstract: The domain third-party.com, frequently used as a placeholder in technical documentation and code samples, has been hijacked. It now targets Windows users with deceptive browser-based lures designed to trick them into executing malicious PowerShell commands via a fake Cloudflare verification page.
stories.why: Developers often copy-paste code snippets containing placeholder domains, inadvertently introducing malicious external dependencies into their own projects and documentation.
stories.action: Audit internal documentation and codebases to remove or replace references to third-party.com.

stories.title: TeamFiltration Campaign Compromises Seven Microsoft 365 Accounts Using Default Passwords
stories.abstract: A campaign dubbed UNK_CondorFiltration is targeting Microsoft 365 tenants, specifically within the Chilean retail and financial sectors. Attackers are leveraging thousands of AWS EC2 instances to conduct brute-force attempts, successfully compromising seven accounts by exploiting weak or default credentials.
stories.why: It highlights the ongoing risk of credential stuffing and the necessity of enforcing multi-factor authentication to mitigate weak password vulnerabilities.
stories.action: Enforce multi-factor authentication and audit Microsoft 365 accounts for weak or default passwords.

stories.abstract: OpenPLC Runtime v3 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthorized actors to hijack session cookies. By impersonating an operator, attackers can issue commands to manipulate programmable logic controllers and disrupt the physical industrial processes they manage.
stories.why: Exploitation grants direct control over critical infrastructure systems, posing significant risks to manufacturing, energy, and water utility operations.
